shots.focal_element: A recreated session-replay player framing a fictional sneaker store (category grid, then the 'Athena 1' product page), with a floating event-log card on the right that appends each user action as it happens.
shots.typography: In-UI text only: storefront uses a condensed, uppercase display face for the logo, product name and accordion labels with mixed-case light body copy; the event-log card uses a clean geometric sans, regular weight, sentence case, with values in small grey pill chips. Product-grid captions and the red error pill are too small to read at sheet resolution.
shots.what_happens: Inside a rounded, glassy replay frame on a vivid gradient backdrop, the store page loads (grid of sneakers), a cluster of coloured dots stands in for the cursor/user as it clicks a product, the page navigates to the Athena 1 detail view, a size dropdown opens, Add to Cart is clicked and fails with a red error pill, then the dots swarm in a rage-click burst, the page blurs, a loading spinner appears and the session changes tab; every action appends a new row to the event log in sync with the narration 'or don't see ... automatically captured from the start. Even as your site evolves' (w157-w176).
shots.build_rebuild: Render a static storefront mock inside a rounded player frame over an animated gradient, drive a cluster of 6-10 coloured dots along a scripted click path, and on each click append a row (icon + verb + grey value chip) to an absolutely positioned event-log card with a short slide-up, ending with a rage-click dot burst, blur-out and spinner.

shots.focal_element: A full-frame field of thousands of overlapping coloured dots (the brand's four dot colours) representing all captured user data.
shots.transition_other: Perspective zoom-through: the replay frame tilts in 3D, fills with tiny dots, and the camera pushes into it until the dots fill the frame.
shots.what_happens: The UI frame swings into perspective and is flooded with confetti-like dots, then the camera flies into it so the whole screen becomes a dense, gently jittering dot field, visualising 'all the historical data' (w177-w189).
shots.build_rebuild: Tilt the previous player frame with a CSS 3D rotateY, spawn a few thousand small circles in four brand colours inside it, then scale the frame past full-screen so the circles grow into a full-bleed dot field with slight per-dot noise motion.

shots.focal_element: The dot field sorting itself into four horizontal colour bands, each labelled with a sentiment and dotted with small emoji-like faces.
shots.transition_other: Continuous particle motion from the previous shot (no visible cut); the mixed dots begin streaming apart.
shots.typography: Rounded, bold sans in sentence case, white fill with a soft dark drop shadow, centred over each band; labels reveal letter by letter (partial 'g gem' and 'Trepida.i' visible mid-reveal).
shots.what_happens: The random dot field streams leftward and separates by colour into four stacked rivers (purple, green, orange, red); a few dots in each band morph into small character faces with matching moods, and the labels Delight, Engagement, Trepidation and Rage type on in sequence as the VO says 'you needed to ask. Plus, with full stories investments' (w190-w198).
shots.build_rebuild: Run a particle simulation where each dot has a colour-based target y-band and lerps toward it with flow to the left, then fade in 2-3 face sprites per band and reveal the four band labels with a per-character stagger of about 40 ms, top to bottom.

shots.focal_element: The orange (trepidation) dot stream flowing through a simplified journey/funnel map card, lighting up nodes until it lands on a 'Dead Click Add to Cart' node where a red flame-like rage character appears.
shots.typography: Node cards use a small regular sans for the event-type label over a bold sentence-case title and small grey metric line; each activated card gains a multicolour gradient top bar. Metric lines on the Athena 1 and Dead Click cards are too small to read reliably.
shots.what_happens: The orange band peels away from the others and streams right as the scene pushes to a peach background with a rounded app frame containing a journey map of skeleton cards joined by curved connectors; the orange particles travel node to node, each card resolving from grey placeholder bars into real content as they pass (White Sneakers, Athena 1, then a third-column node becoming 'Dead Click Add to Cart'), a red rage character pops up on that node, and the particle cluster drifts off as the frame slides away, under 'machine learning and AI, that data is automatically collected, translated, and ready to activate in real time. And by integrating' (w199-w219).
shots.build_rebuild: Draw a 3-column node graph with SVG bezier connectors inside a rounded card, move a cluster of ~80 orange circles along the connector paths with a motion-path tween, and when the cluster reaches each node swap its skeleton bars for title text and a gradient top bar, finishing with a red character sprite popping in on the final node.
